ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the producer schema, consumer versions and the breaking-change flag are declared; it does not compare live schemas.
offer: Verify producer and consumer compatibility against the same schema. Breaking a consumer contract needs a deliberate transition rather than updating only the producer fixture.

minimal.reason: Declare the producer schema consumers rely on. Without it compatibility has no reference, so point to the schema file.

mid.reason: List the consumer versions that must keep working. An empty list ignores existing callers, so name each version.

maximal.reason: Set allowing breaking change to false. Breaking a consumer needs a deliberate transition, not a producer-only fixture update.
